errors.text_span: разходите за придобиване на дестинирани материали (ДМА)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly interprets the abbreviation ДМА (Дълготрайни материални активи - Tangible fixed assets) as 'дестинирани материали' (destined materials), which is nonsensical in this context.

This phrase is used for all three lines. The data is represented by solid lines, not lines with markers. The dotted trend lines have circular points, but the description is detailing the values from the solid data lines.
The repetitive phrasing 'gray-gray-gray' is awkward and unnatural.

errors.text_span: намаляват до около 17 000 хил. лв. в 2020 година
errors.evidence: For the yellow line ('38.3. Рециклиране на материали'), the minimum value is reached in 2019 (at approx. 16,000), not 2020. The value in 2020 is slightly higher (approx. 18,000).
